summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (formerly Galapagos NV), a Belgian biotech listed on Euronext and NASDAQ, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, disclosing weekly share repurchases under the program announced June 9, 2026. Between August 24–28, 2026, it repurchased 127,796 ordinary shares at an average price of €25.19, totaling €3,218,710.15, via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary across Euronext venues. Post-transaction, Lakefront holds 1,161,324 own shares. This represents ongoing open-market buybacks under an issuer repurchase program, not a tender offer. The filing summarizes executed trades with price ranges; no premiums, advisors, or structural changes are noted. What to watch: continued execution pace and aggregate repurchase progress toward program limits.
